name: ICPC 开屏动画
author: ttbr5145
description: 给 DSH 的 Web 界面加一段 ICPC 标识开场影片：标准片头 5 秒、霓虹片头 6 秒，也可随时关掉；点画面或按 Esc 跳过。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；两个 mp4 原样提供，不转码不抽帧，素材路由真实现 Range。
descriptionEn: A full-screen ICPC ident intro for the DSH web client: a 5-second intro cut and a 6-second neon cut, or off; skippable by click or Esc. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so DSH's built-in loading card never shows. Both mp4 files are served untouched — no transcode, no frame extraction — over routes with real Range support.
